thread:
Ivy: quick heads-up — the console 'cost & latency breakdown' example uses `route` labels but our SDK now emits `route_name` in metadata. docs are out of sync and panels show empty series.
Noah: yep saw that in staging. two options: change docs to `route_name` or recommend both labels in queries via `coalesce(route, route_name, 'unknown')`.
Lucy: prefer updating docs to reflect current SDK but also add migration note for older dashboards. small snippet suggestion for PromQL?
Noah: here's a compact PromQL we can add: `sum(cost_total) by (coalesce(route, route_name, 'unknown'))`. mention it works when traces are unsampled.
Ivy: also need tiny SDK snippets for both node + python showing metadata key `route_name`.
Lucy: node example: `await client.generate('', {metadata:{route_name:'billing_v3'}})`. python: `resp = client.generate("", metadata={"route_name":"billing_v3"})`. short and sweet.
Ivy: i'll open a PR to update docs, add migration note: "If your dashboards used `route`, update queries to coalesce to `route_name` or update SDKs."
docbot: New PR opened: #2168 — docs(console): align cost/latency examples with SDK metadata key route_name + migration note.
Noah: please include a one-line regression test (curl) to ensure panels don't 500 when span_id missing.
Ivy: added `curl -s -XPOST https://metrics-api.internal/query -d '{"query":"sum(cost_total) by (coalesce(route, route_name, \"unknown\"))"}' | jq` to the PR.
Lucy: LGTM, approving now.
Ivy: merged. closing thread.
